notes: RISC-V entries refreshed 2026-11-11 from /tmp/rv-vertical2 (see docs/EVIDENCE-riscv.md); the other targets remain the 2026-11-10 snapshot. Artifacts live under /tmp; `command` regenerates them. verify-evidence.sh checks sha256 + the recorded summary. U-full/* are the --limit 0 universes (one file per target, expanded across every configuration by `oracle expand`); the full query file is not frozen (144-473 MB) - its sha256 and the expand command are in docs/EVIDENCE-U.md, and the frozen universe plus that command regenerate it byte-for-byte. MIR-L1/arm, arm-neg, ppc, mips and mips-neg added 2026-11-12 (constructor swap for the three targets; PPC's only MIR file has no generic opcode, so its L1 line is nominal — see docs/GAPS.md O1). PPC L2 added 2026-11-12: the upstream MIR corpus has no generic opcode, so the query-derived set is what actually exercises its rules. ARM/Mips L2 added 2026-11-12 (configs in data/mir-configs.json, checked by mir-config-check.py); G_LOAD is the negative control for both because their generated include builds FADD in two chains. M68k/Wasm L2 added 2026-11-12 as well; both constructors are rule tables only, so the swap is the generic body. SPIR-V L2 added 2026-11-12 with per-target configs (env from the triple, extensions via --spirv-ext); its G_SPLAT_VECTOR queries are skipped because SPIR-VPreLegalizer splits splats before the legalizer and the rule table itself indexes Types[4]/Types[16] (docs/REPORT-mir.md 6.9). G/U/x86, G/U/aarch64 and G/U/riscv re-run 2026-11-14 after gisel switched the include to public builders (r28); query sets and agree counts are unchanged.
